title: Gerente Comercial Varejo - Manaus/AM (atuação no interior)

Essa é uma posição de confiança, que exige ética, autonomia e visão de negócios para oferecer soluções financeiras que promovam o crescimento sustentável dos nossos clientes. Aqui, valorizamos pessoas que têm protagonismo, disciplina e paixão pelo que fazem , que constroem relações de confiança e que atuam com visão estratégica para transformar o varejo junto com a gente. Responsabilidades e atribuições No seu dia a dia, você será responsável por: Mapear estrategicamente a área de atuação, identificando oportunidades e planejando rotas para visitas externas. Elaborar planos de ação alinhados às metas, conduzindo negociações com autonomia e responsabilidade. Realizar atendimento consultivo e presencial, oferecendo soluções financeiras adequadas às necessidades de cada cliente. Prospectar novos clientes e oportunidades, ampliando a base de relacionamento e fortalecendo negócios integrados ao Sistema Integrado Martins (SIM). Gerir a carteira de clientes com foco em resultados, acompanhando indicadores financeiros, inadimplência e rentabilidade. Atuar na concessão e renovação de crédito, avaliando riscos e participando de comitês de crédito. Protagonismo : assumir responsabilidade pelos resultados e buscar melhorias contínuas. Relacionamento Interpessoal : construir confiança e parcerias sólidas. Inteligência Emocional & Resiliência : lidar com metas altas e cenários competitivos com equilíbrio. Comunicação Estratégica : transmitir ideias com clareza e impacto. Requisitos básicos Superior completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Economia ou áreas correlatas. CNH B válida. Certificação ANBIMA CPA-10 ou superior (ativa). Residir em Manus/AM. Vivência no segmento varejista. Conhecimento de produtos bancários e análise financeira. O que vamos te oferecer Assistência médica. Assistência odontológica. Previdência Privada. Participação de Resultados. Formação e desenvolvimento (Simplisfica TRI). Seguro de Vida. Auxílio Alimentação e Refeição. Auxílio Creche/Escola ou Babá para quem tem filhos até 6 anos. Academia física em Uberlândia. Dress Code: a regra aqui é “Venha do seu Jeito!”. Gympass. Vidalink: Desconto para compra de medicamentos. Day Off no mês do seu aniversário. Triclub para Uberlândia e São Paulo. Programas voltados para o bem-estar: Jeito Leve de Ser, Única Mente. Programa de indicação. Equipamentos fornecidos pela empresa. title: Gerente De Loja - Boa Vista Roraima
description:
Empresa está contratando Gerente De Loja - Boa Vista Roraima em boa vista. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Na história da Rede de Farmácias Pague Menos e Extrafarma , saúde e bem-estar são origem, mas também propósito. Para nós, promover o acesso à saúde significa liberdade e dignidade. Somos uma empresa brasileira, feita de gente apaixonada por gente. Estamos presente em todos os estados do país, por isso, somos gigantes e diversos por natureza! Nosso história começou em 1981, quando inauguramos nossa primeira loja em Fortaleza-CE e por meio da valorização humana , da superação de resultados , do foco no cliente , da sustentabilidade , da integridade e da inovação em soluções nos tornamos a segunda maior rede de farmácias do Brasil. Nosso modelo de negócios é baseado na venda de produtos e serviços voltados para a saúde e bem-estar dos nossos clientes. Atuamos no mercado de varejo de especialidade, seguindo o conceito de drugstore. Buscamos ser não somente uma rede de farmácias, mas um hub integrado de saúde . Desta forma, implementamos, a partir de 2016, o Clinic Farma, consultório farmacêutico o qual nossos clientes recebem, em salas equipadas e confortáveis, acompanhamento individualizado em seus tratamentos. Hoje, somos mais de 25 mil gigantes unidos por um mesmo propósito: assegurar acesso a uma saúde de qualidade no Brasil para que mais pessoas vivam plenamente . Se você tem amor por servir e é gente que cuida de gente, vem ser Gigante! Aqui, quem acredita e trabalha cresce. Qualificações Formado em farmácia, administração ou outras áreas correlatas à função. Conhecimento em informática. Experiência em liderar equipes e organizar processos administrativos. Experiência com vendas e atendimento ao cliente. Responsabilidades Fechar caixas: atualizando o sistema financeiro da loja. Garantir a troca de dinheiro mantendo a loja abastecida de dinheiro trocado para atendimento aos clientes. Realizar auditoria financeira. Executar o “book de execução mensal” montando exposições de vendas (móvel ilha, bailarina, check out, pontas de gôndolas). Garantir a confecção de kits promocionais. Aplicar as negociações de loja: verificando as negociações vigentes (clip strips, ponta de gondolas, wobblers, etc). Responsável pela manutenção da loja organizada: garantir a limpeza, rupturas, precificação e abastecimento das seções. Atendimento ao cliente. Conferir documentos tais como: cancelados, trocas, devoluções, libercard, comprovante de cartões mantendo os comprovantes organizados, bem como identificar alguma divergência. Analisar relatórios de indicadores para acompanhamento da evolução da loja. Realizar feedbacks semanais e mensal com a equipe com base na análise dos indicadores anteriores, para buscar sempre superar as metas de cada um. Realizar inventário parcial: mantendo o estoque da loja atualizado, corrigindo possíveis rupturas devido a furtos, assim como também acompanhar equipe inventário total. Arquivar documentos: mantendo os documentos fiscais (trocas, devoluções, cancelados, comprovantes de cartões) arquivados em loja em caso de necessidade de fiscalização ou comprovações de vendas. Supervisionar a conferência dos produtos a vencer: acompanhando a equipe de loja na conferência dos produtos a vencer nas suas seções. Realizar treinamentos: treinando a equipe sempre que necessário em diversos temas (atendimento, vendas, sistemas operacionais, indicadores de loja). Gerenciar equipe de loja: montagem de escalas, fluxos de atendimentos, gerenciamento de conflitos, dentre outros. Planejamento estratégico: realizar o planejamento anual da loja, com base nos indicadores anteriores. #J-18808-Ljbffr

title: Wanted: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Wanted: Senior Machine Learning Engineer em boa vista. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

O varejo físico responde por mais de 80% das vendas no Brasil — e nenhuma das conversas entre vendedor e cliente virava dado. A KOL resolve isso: capturamos interações no PDV via áudio e entregamos inteligência real para gestores de varejo. Produto validado, pipeline ativo, estágio inicial. Cada pessoa que entra agora está construindo o que a KOL vai se tornar. Buscamos um Senior Machine Learning Engineer para compor o nosso Founding Team e assumir a camada de speech e inteligência conversacional — os sistemas que transformam conversas reais em lojas físicas em transcrições, insights estruturados e sinais acionáveis para gestores. Você vai trabalhar onde a qualidade da IA determina o valor que o cliente percebe. O que você fará Assumir ownership pelo pipeline de speech-to-text e análise conversacional. Avaliar e melhorar qualidade de transcrição em ambientes ruidosos de lojas físicas. Trabalhar em diarização, identificação de papéis dos interlocutores e processamento de transcrições. Desenhar fluxos com LLMs para extração estruturada de insights, resumos, objeções e comportamentos de venda. Construir datasets de avaliação, métricas de qualidade, feedback loops e versionamento de modelos e prompts. Fazer benchmarks de provedores de speech-to-text, diarização e LLMs. Trabalhar com produto e engenharia para tornar insights de IA confiáveis e acionáveis. Forte experiência em IA aplicada, engenharia de ML, NLP, speech ou engenharia de dados. Forte experiência com Python. Experiência construindo pipelines em produção, não apenas notebooks ou experimentos. Experiência com LLMs, extração estruturada, versionamento de prompts e modelos, e avaliação. Capacidade de trabalhar com dados reais, ambíguos e ruidosos. Forte senso de produto em torno de qualidade, confiabilidade e confiança do usuário em sistemas de IA. Diferenciais Experiência com speech-to-text, diarização, processamento de áudio ou dados conversacionais ruidosos. Experiência com fluxos de anotação, revisão humana ou otimização de custo e latência em IA. Você pode ser a pessoa certa se... Você já colocou um pipeline de IA em produção, viu ele falhar de formas inesperadas com dados reais e construiu os mecanismos de avaliação para entender exatamente onde e por quê. Você não considera um modelo bom porque performou bem no benchmark: só quando funciona com os dados bagunçados do mundo real. Você se importa com a confiança do usuário final no output da IA — e sabe que essa confiança é construída com métricas, feedback loop e muito trabalho de avaliação, não com hype. #J-18808-Ljbffr

Because this is a new setup, you won't be slotting into someone else's playbook. You'll define how we review designs, how we work with ANATEL labs, how we support customers, and how we train the next engineers who join the team. You'll work hands-on with hardware, sit across the table from customer engineering teams, and partner with Quectel's global R&D centers to bring solutions home for the LATAM market. "Joining a brand-new operation means you're not just doing the work — you're deciding how the work gets done. That's rare, and it's the reason engineers stay." What You'll Do Partner with LATAM customers to understand their products, then design hardware architectures and recommend the right Quectel solutions. Review schematics and PCB layouts in Altium, Cadence, or PADS — and turn your feedback into better, more reliable designs. Get hands-on at the bench: power supply analysis, signal integrity, oscilloscope work, debugging interface and certification issues. Be the trusted technical voice for our LATAM customers — answering tough questions and solving complex problems alongside our global engineering teams. Lead technical discussions with customers and certification labs, including ANATEL homologation activities. Write the application notes, design guidelines, and FAQs that help customers ship faster. Train internal FAE and Sales teams across the region — your expertise will scale across LATAM. Support the project team with BOM preparation for fast, accurate customer quotations. What You Bring Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 3–5 years of hardware design or hardware support experience — bonus if you've worked in customer-facing or FAE roles. Solid grasp of hardware fundamentals: CPU, memory, PMU, system interfaces. Strong skills in power supply design, power sequencing, charging, and power consumption analysis. Comfortable with serial interfaces — I²C, SPI, UART, USIM — for integration and debug. Confident with bench tools: power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes. Hands-on with at least one EDA tool (Altium Designer, Cadence, or PADS). Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus. Bonus Points For Experience designing PCBA end-to-end. Deep knowledge of USB 2.0/3.0, USB hub architecture, USB Type-C. Experience with high-speed interfaces: MIPI DSI/CSI, PCIe, SDIO. RF testing experience across cellular (2G/3G/4G/5G) and Wi-Fi 802.11. Background in PC, mobile, server, or FWA system integration. Prior ANATEL homologation experience. Team leadership or technical mentoring experience. The Tech You'll Work With Quectel's full product portfolio — cellular (5G/LTE/LPWA), GNSS, smart modules, and antennas. Quectel services — including device certification work for ANATEL and other regional bodies. See it in action — Quectel customer stories from automotive, smart metering, agribusiness, and more. Why You'll Love Working Here Founding-team energy — you're not joining an established office, you're building one. The processes, the culture, the technical playbook — you'll help write it. Real impact from day one — your decisions and designs ship inside products used by millions across LATAM. Backed by a global leader — startup feel, but with the technology, customers, and resources of a 4,000-person publicly-listed IoT company behind you. Direct line to global R&D — work side-by-side with our R&D centers in China, Europe, and North America while staying rooted in Manaus's growing tech ecosystem. Cutting-edge technology — 5G, LPWA, AI at the edge, smart camera modules, and the next generation of connected devices. Career growth on a fast curve — early team members typically grow into senior technical or leadership roles as the operation scales. Customer-facing exposure — directly shape how leading LATAM brands build their connected products. Competitive package — attractive compensation, benefits, and the stability of a global market leader. Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks. Performance bonus / sales commission structure (role dependent). Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance). Health insurance with no co-pay. Life insurance. Paid time off. International travel opportunities — HQ visits and global trade shows. Ready to Apply? If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you. title: Hardware engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Hardware engineer em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Hardware Electronics Engineer Be a founding member of Quectel's new LATAM hub in Manaus Location Manaus, Amazonas, Brazil Role Hardware Electronics Engineer – LATAM Level Mid-Level (1-3 years of experience) Type Full-Time, On-Site Languages Portuguese & English required · Spanish a plus About Quectel Quectel is one of the world's leading suppliers of cellular Io T modules, antennas, and connectivity services, with more than 4,000 professionals across 8 R& D centers and 50+ sales offices worldwide. Our technology powers everything from smart meters and connected cars to industrial robots and point-of-sale terminals — quietly enabling billions of devices to talk to the cloud. A New Chapter: Quectel in Manaus This is something special. Quectel is launching a brand-new operation in Manaus, Brazil — and we're building the founding team right now. Hosted at ICT Manaus (Instituto Centro de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento em Tecnologia de Software), an accredited Science, Technology and Innovation Institution under SUFRAMA's CAPDA framework, this new setup will become Quectel's regional engine for R& D, customer enablement, and ANATEL certification across Latin America. Joining now means more than taking a job — it means shaping a team, a culture, and a way of working from day one. Your fingerprints will be on everything we build here. Learn more about Quectel: Company website — Our history & global footprint — LATAM in action — Furukawa Electric Lat Am customer story (Brazil) Follow us on Linked In The Role We're hiring the founding hardware engineer for Quectel's brand-new Manaus operation. You'll be the first technical point of contact — and the technical voice — for customers across Latin America who are building tomorrow's connected products on Quectel modules: automotive telematics, smart energy, industrial Io T, connected payments, and more. Because this is a new setup, you won't be slotting into someone else's playbook. You'll define how we review designs, how we work with ANATEL labs, how we support customers, and how we train the next engineers who join the team. You'll work hands-on with hardware, sit across the table from customer engineering teams, and partner with Quectel's global R& D centers to bring solutions home for the LATAM market. " Joining a brand-new operation means you're not just doing the work — you're deciding how the work gets done. That's rare, and it's the reason engineers stay." What You'll Do Partner with LATAM customers to understand their products, then design hardware architectures and recommend the right Quectel solutions. Review schematics and PCB layouts in Altium, Cadence, or PADS — and turn your feedback into better, more reliable designs. Get hands-on at the bench: power supply analysis, signal integrity, oscilloscope work, debugging interface and certification issues. Be the trusted technical voice for our LATAM customers — answering tough questions and solving complex problems alongside our global engineering teams. Lead technical discussions with customers and certification labs, including ANATEL homologation activities. Write the application notes, design guidelines, and FAQs that help customers ship faster. Train internal FAE and Sales teams across the region — your expertise will scale across LATAM. Support the project team with BOM preparation for fast, accurate customer quotations. What You Bring Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 3–5 years of hardware design or hardware support experience — bonus if you've worked in customer-facing or FAE roles. Solid grasp of hardware fundamentals: CPU, memory, PMU, system interfaces. Strong skills in power supply design, power sequencing, charging, and power consumption analysis. Comfortable with serial interfaces — I² C, SPI, UART, USIM — for integration and debug. Confident with bench tools: power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes. Hands-on with at least one EDA tool (Altium Designer, Cadence, or PADS). Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus. Bonus Points For Experience designing PCBA end-to-end. Deep knowledge of USB 2.0/3.0, USB hub architecture, USB Type-C. Experience with high-speed interfaces: MIPI DSI/CSI, PCIe, SDIO. RF testing experience across cellular (2 G/3 G/4 G/5 G) and Wi-Fi 802.11. Background in PC, mobile, server, or FWA system integration. Prior ANATEL homologation experience. Team leadership or technical mentoring experience. The Tech You'll Work With Quectel's full product portfolio — cellular (5 G/LTE/LPWA), GNSS, smart modules, and antennas. Quectel services — including device certification work for ANATEL and other regional bodies. See it in action — Quectel customer stories from automotive, smart metering, agribusiness, and more. Why You'll Love Working Here Founding-team energy — you're not joining an established office, you're building one. The processes, the culture, the technical playbook — you'll help write it. Real impact from day one — your decisions and designs ship inside products used by millions across LATAM. Backed by a global leader — startup feel, but with the technology, customers, and resources of a 4,000-person publicly-listed Io T company behind you. Direct line to global R& D — work side-by-side with our R& D centers in China, Europe, and North America while staying rooted in Manaus's growing tech ecosystem. Cutting-edge technology — 5 G, LPWA, AI at the edge, smart camera modules, and the next generation of connected devices. Career growth on a fast curve — early team members typically grow into senior technical or leadership roles as the operation scales. Customer-facing exposure — directly shape how leading LATAM brands build their connected products. Competitive package — attractive compensation, benefits, and the stability of a global market leader. Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks. Performance bonus / sales commission structure (role dependent). Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance). Health insurance with no co-pay. Life insurance. Paid time off. International travel opportunities — HQ visits and global trade shows. Ready to Apply? If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Send your CV (in English) along with a short note about what excites you most about the role. We review applications on a rolling basis. Apply via: sasha.saini@ | Browse open roles: Quectel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

The Regional Study Director, LATAM may oversee other regional study leads within the region to facilitate a streamlined and quality study execution. This role will also work internally and externally with members of the cross-functional study team. Manage and build relationships with clinical research sites in LATAM. May oversee the work of other regional study leads within LATAM. Develop region specific the subject recruitment/retention strategy and related initiatives. Oversight of regional TMF ongoing quality review, and final reconciliation of study documents including review of site regulatory documents/packages and obtaining of appropriate site insurance, and/or supervision of team members performing these activities. Data flow from sites to data processing, review, and resolution. Analysis and report generation. Knowledge of local regulatory requirements. Ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action Travel: You may be required to travel for up to 25-50% of your time.

Employment Type: Full-time position employed by a partner agency (3rd party, B2 B) About Sisense Sisense is a leading AI-powered Analytics Platform as a Service (An Paa S) that empowers product teams and developers to embed conversational, predictive, and agentic intelligence directly into applications and workflows. Our API-first, developer-first platform turns complex data into faster, smarter, actionable decisions for global customers across financial services, retail, healthcare, and technology. With the recent launch of Sisense Intelligence and the Intelligence Assistant, we are accelerating innovation in embedded analytics, enabling governed, scalable AI experiences that bridge insights to real-time action. The Role As a Strategic Customer Success Manager, you will serve as a trusted advisor to mid-sized to large enterprise accounts. You will build deep relationships, drive adoption of our AI-powered platform, maximize value, and fuel retention and expansion. You will collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Product, Engineering, and Support to ensure customers achieve their business goals through clear communication and proactive guidance. Why Join Our Customer Success Team This is a strategic, high-impact role where you will own complex accounts, strengthen multi-threaded relationships, and deliver measurable outcomes (NRR, expansion revenue, AI feature adoption). You will work in a collaborative, innovative global environment, partnering with diverse teams to solve real customer challenges and contribute to Sisense's growth in embedded AI analytics. About You You thrive in fast-paced, evolving environments, adapting quickly while staying positive and solution-focused. You are a natural relationship builder, skilled at nurturing trusted, multi-level partnerships and positioning yourself as a key advisor. You quickly grasp business goals and technical concepts (including AI/analytics platforms) to align solutions with customer needs. You are proactive and consultative, identifying opportunities, anticipating challenges, and advocating for customers while balancing business priorities. You are collaborative, open to feedback, and passionate about delivering results through continuous learning. Requirements 3–5 years as a Customer Success Manager (or equivalent), with proven success managing enterprise/mid-market accounts (Saa S/BI/analytics preferred). Strong track record driving product adoption, value realization, NRR, and revenue expansion. Excellent presentation and executive communication skills; experience leading EBRs/QBRs and building C-level relationships. Ability to own full account planning, health monitoring, and success strategy across a portfolio. Proactive mindset: identify upsell/cross-sell opportunities, mitigate risks, and deliver measurable ROI. Project management skills to handle complex implementations, onboarding, and technical discussions. Experience collaborating cross-functionally (Sales, Product, Engineering) to resolve issues and influence roadmaps. Exceptional interpersonal, listening, written, and verbal skills (fluent English required; Portuguese a plus). Results-driven with critical thinking, problem-solving, and a customer-centric focus. Comfortable in a dynamic, remote environment managing multiple priorities. Bonus: Background in Business Intelligence (BI), embedded analytics, AI/Gen AI enablement, or similar technical solutions. How You'll Ramp By Day 30 Complete Customer Success onboarding and training (Sisense values, culture, relationship techniques, product overview, competition, and transformational outcomes). Begin meeting customers, shadowing QBRs/EBRs, and observing how we build relationships and deliver value. By Day 60 Develop strategic account plans for your portfolio and start driving opportunities (adoption, expansion, renewals). Deepen product/technical knowledge through coaching and hands-on work. Fully embed with your accounts and collaborate side-by-side with the team. By Day 90 Own your book of business end-to-end, driving partnership success and measurable results (NRR, adoption, expansion). Master Customer Success best practices, including onboarding, proactive risk management, and AI feature enablement. Become a key contributor to the team's revenue retention and growth goals. What We Offer Employment through a partner agency (B2 B). Competitive base salary up to USD 3,500 per month (depending on experience). Eligibility for a quarterly performance bonus. Opportunity to work with a global leader in AI-powered embedded analytics. Flexible remote work with a collaborative international team. Professional development and growth opportunities within Customer Success.

title: Regional study director, latam
description:
Empresa está contratando Regional study director, latam em palmas. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Crinetics is a pharmaceutical company headquartered in San Diego, California, with a growing presence in Latin America, including an office in Brazil. We are developing much-needed therapies for people with endocrine diseases and endocrine-related tumors. We were founded by a dedicated team of scientists with the simple belief that better therapies developed from rigorous innovation can lead to better lives. Our work continues to make a real difference in the lives of patients. We have a prolific discovery engine and a robust preclinical and clinical development pipeline. We are driven by science with a patient-centric and team-oriented culture. Crinetics is known for its inclusive workplace culture. This is an exciting time to join Crinetics as we expand our operations in Latin America and shape our organization into the world's premier fully integrated endocrine company from discovery to patients. Join our team as we transform the lives of others. Position Summary: Please note, the candidate for this role will need to be located in Brazil. The Regional Study Director, LATAM is responsible for managing the execution of clinical studies and data collection within the LATAM region. The incumbent will serve as a regional clinical study lead who oversees the review, monitoring, and adherence to clinical protocols, as well as managing and building relationships with clinical sites in LATAM. The Regional Study Director, LATAM may oversee other regional study leads within the region to facilitate a streamlined and quality study execution. This role will also work internally and externally with members of the cross-functional study team. Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities: These may include but are not limited to: Provide oversight of clinical research studies for LATAM. Manage and build relationships with clinical research sites in LATAM. May oversee the work of other regional study leads within LATAM. Provide operational and strategic input into study documents such as synopsis, protocol, ICF, CRFs, CRF Completion Guidelines, Study Execution Plans, Clinical Data Review Plan, Clinical Database edit specifications, Clinical Study Report (CSR) development, etc. Oversight of all regional vendors and activities including CROs. Oversee regional start up activities including site selection, enrollment projections and activities driving site activation. Develop region specific the subject recruitment/retention strategy and related initiatives. Oversight of regional TMF ongoing quality review, and final reconciliation of study documents including review of site regulatory documents/packages and obtaining of appropriate site insurance, and/or supervision of team members performing these activities. Development of training materials for study team, investigational sites, and vendors. Proactive management of information sharing with key stakeholders using standardized reports and other mechanisms. Assure clinical studies are compliant with GDPR, ICH/GCP and other regulations as appropriate. Outline regional activation hurdles for team. Participate in RFP development and prepare bid templates to facilitate selection of the CROs/vendors, and/or collaboration/supervision with team members performing these activities. Collaborate with counsel to negotiate and draft research contracts and agreements with CROs/vendors and clinical study sites, as needed. Acts as liaison with Regulatory Affairs to assure adherence to GDPR, GCPs; maintenance of SOPs; and assure site and CRO/vendor audits are completed. Perform regional risk management and implement mitigations. Identify potential study issues and recommend and implement solutions or corrective actions as needed. Create realistic plans that clearly define goals, milestones, responsibilities, and results. Maintain focus on strategic objectives while accomplishing operational goals. Make timely, data-driven decisions. Manage daily activities, assign tasks, goals, and development of direct reports. Other duties as assigned. Required Education and Experience: Bachelor's degree required, preferably in scientific discipline. An equivalent combination of relevant education and applicable job experience may be considered. 12 years of prior clinical operations experience preferably with CRO/small biotech experience and approximately 8 years of experience in a supervisory role. Must be able to travel 25-50% of time, may be higher in accordance with project requirements. Computer skills should include proficiency with Microsoft Office suite of software, electronic TMF systems, IXRS and EDC systems. Excellent understanding of drug development process. Experience in clinical trial supply management. Able to make appropriate decisions to move the project(s) forward. Effective verbal and written communication skills. Data flow from sites to data processing, review, and resolution. Analysis and report generation. Knowledge of local regulatory requirements. Ability to handle multiple tasks to meet deadlines in a dynamic environment is essential. Study initiation procedures. Ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action Travel: You may be required to travel for up to 25-50% of your time.

Role Overview Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company's foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration. Key Responsibilities Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation) Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes. Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes. Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations. Automation, Integration & AI Implementation Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our Saa S ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.g., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, Java Script). Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks. Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software. IT Administration & Security Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365). Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access. Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security. Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate Saa S contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl. Required Qualifications & Skills Technical Experience: 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration. Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment. Strong understanding of cloud-based Saa S ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures. High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.g., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting. Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows. Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols. Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies: Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity. Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving; ability to identify the root causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms. Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution; capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions. In short, here are some reasons why you will love working as an Online English Teacher with Latin Hire: Up to 30 hours of shifts available per week! You be your own boss and set your own schedule Work from anywhere (as long as you have good Wi Fi, workspace, computer, webcam, and microphone). C1 or C2 Level English Speaker University degree in English Teaching or related area. One year of experience in teaching English as a foreign language. Who we are: Established in 2003, Latin Hire recruits and manages teams of subject matter experts (SMEs) for online education companies. For over 20 years, our teams have played key roles in the backend of very successful educational startups.

title: Full stack engineer
description:
Confira a vaga para Full stack engineer em palmas. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About Freight Hero Freight Hero is an AI-native services company built to support the freight brokerage industry, which is in dire need of it. Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent. We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures. The thesis is proven. What is next is growth, and that means building a team of incredible people around us to push the company to the next level. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs. About the Role This is a senior full‐stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.js, Type Script, React, and AWS. You won't be inheriting a legacy monolith. You'll be contributing to a modern, event‐driven, AI‐powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates. You'll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you'll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices. What Success Looks Like A successful engineer in this role: Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.js/Type Script that integrate deeply with customer systems. Designs and maintains AWS‐native infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‐efficient. Works cross‐functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions. Ships high‐quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence. Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform. Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities: Full Stack Engineering Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.js + Type Script. Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + Vue JS. Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices. AWS native Architecture Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, Dynamo DB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more. Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‐optimized. Systems Integration Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‐specific tools. Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions. AI Forward Development Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‐powered workflows into the product. Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks. Identify opportunities to expand AI‐driven automation across the platform. Collaboration & Impact Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs. Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning. Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows. What We Are Looking For 8+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong expertise in Node.js, Type Script, React, and AWS cloud architecture. Experience building distributed systems, event‐driven architectures, or workflow automation. Comfortable working across the stack (backend‐heavy, but able to contribute to frontend). Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‐technical teams. High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‐moving, ambiguous environments. Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‐to‐day work. Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems. Why Freight Hero Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2 B tech. Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes. Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales. Competitive compensation with performance incentives. Fully remote with a collaborative, high‐performance culture.

The role includes SAE reconciliation, meeting compliance and productivity targets, and supporting onboarding and training for new team members. Proficiency with Argus safety database and MS Office Suite. Minimum 2 years of experience in drug safety/pharmacovigilance or relevant clinical experience. Excellent communication, problem-solving, time management, and attention to detail. Global cultural awareness and collaborative mindset.

description:
Empresa está contratando Portuguese language specialist em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Position Overview: As a Gen AI Data Annotation Analyst, you will play a critical role in developing high-quality datasets that power the next generation of Large Language Models (LLMs). You will evaluate, generate, and refine multi-modal data (text, image, or video) to ensure AI outputs are accurate, safe, and culturally resonant for the Portuguese market. Key Responsibilities Multi-Modal Annotation: Label and categorize high-quality training data across text, image, and video formats with surgical precision. Content Generation: Draft grammatically flawless, creative, and factually accurate text in both Portuguese and English, adapting tone and style for specific project needs. Edge-Case Resolution: Apply logical reasoning to resolve ambiguous data scenarios where guidelines may not explicitly cover a specific nuance. Continuous Feedback: Identify and report bugs within internal annotation tools and suggest workflow optimizations. Cross-Functional Sync: Collaborate with Leads and Project Managers to calibrate on quality benchmarks and project pivots. System Requirements (Mandatory): Full set of desktop/Laptop with Windows 11 Pro. Bring a compliant device. Windows 11 Pro (Home editions not allowed) or mac OS 12+, 8 GB RAM, 50 GB free disk. Tablets/Chromebooks/phones won't be accepted. Network: Stable Internet connection, which should have a speed of up to 40 MBPS Requirements: Bachelor's degree/ diploma or equivalent educational qualification. Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in annotation tasks, linguistic data handling, or related AI/ML projects. Demonstrated experience working with data annotation tools and software platforms. Strong understanding of language nuances, including grammar, style, and cultural context. Ability to adapt quickly to changing project directions and fast-paced work environments. Previous experience creating or annotating complex data specifically for Large Language Model (LLM) training. Familiarity with annotation projects involving sensitive or nuanced content. Prior exposure to Generative AI technologies and principles. What We Offer: An innovative and supportive global working environment. Opportunities for continuous learning and growth. Competitive compensation and remote working arrangements. Engagement in impactful projects at the forefront of AI technology. Join i Merit to be part of shaping high-quality datasets powering the next generation of Generative AI solutions. If precision, critical analysis, and innovation excite you, we encourage you to apply!

title: Marketing designer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Marketing designer em manaus. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

AI Marketing Designer Full-time, Remote | US Central Time Business Hours A letter from our client Our client wanted us to share this role directly in their own words because they're looking for someone exceptional to help them continue growing the right way. Over the past decade, their agency has grown to support 100+ clients across multiple industries, and they are continuing to scale carefully and intentionally. Maintaining a healthy team culture, avoiding burnout, and delivering high-quality work are major priorities for them. Their clients range from mission-driven organizations changing lives, to restaurant and hospitality brands, to innovative tech companies building exciting products. In recent years, the agency has become a trusted partner for businesses that previously had poor experiences with marketing agencies and lost confidence in the process. Their mission is not only to deliver great work, but also to help educate businesses on how modern digital marketing should actually be done. Why this role exists Currently, the owner personally handles much of the AI-assisted production work within the agency. This includes designing social media content, building websites, generating content with AI tools, and migrating websites onto a modern development stack. The systems are working extremely well, allowing the agency to move faster than teams much larger in size. However, he has become the bottleneck. They are now looking for someone who can take ownership of execution so leadership can focus more heavily on strategy, growth, and client relationships. The role This position is equal parts: AI fluency Design and web development Both skill sets must be strong. On the AI side: Their ideal candidate actively uses tools like Claude, Chat GPT, and Gemini as part of a daily workflow. They understand prompting for content, imagery, coding, research, and strategy. They see AI as a multiplier for creativity and execution rather than a replacement for skill. On the design and development side: The candidate should be able to design professionally in Canva and Photoshop while maintaining brand consistency across multiple industries and aesthetics. They should also feel comfortable building and migrating websites using tools such as Next.js, Vercel, Git Hub, and AI-assisted coding workflows. The team values people who understand the balance between beautiful design and conversion-focused performance. Agency experience is strongly preferred, especially for someone familiar with fast turnarounds, proactive communication, and problem-solving before issues escalate. What the role includes Designing social media content for multiple brands and industries Building and migrating websites onto modern frameworks Using AI tools to accelerate production workflows Assisting with content creation, research, image generation, and code scaffolding Creating designs that are both visually strong and performance-driven Staying current on new AI tools, workflows, and technologies Collaborating with leadership to improve internal systems and efficiency What our client is looking for Strong AI workflow experience using tools like Claude, Chat GPT, or Gemini Experience with AI-assisted coding tools Professional Canva and Photoshop skills Comfort using Git Hub, Vercel, and modern web development workflows Basic SEO understanding Strong understanding of social media design across platforms Strong written and spoken English Availability during US Central Time business hours Previous agency experience preferred A highly proactive and self-directed mindset What they DO NOT want Someone who requires constant follow-up Someone who treats AI as a gimmick or shortcut Someone who forces one design style onto every brand Someone who confuses being busy with being effective Someone unwilling to continuously learn and adapt Portfolio required Applicants must submit a live portfolio URL with their application. Their team would like to see: At least 5 projects A mix of social media and website work At least one live website built end-to-end Optional examples showing how AI supported the workflow What it's like working with them They work hard, move quickly, and genuinely enjoy what they do. Their culture values humility, creativity, initiative, and excellence. There is strong room for growth within the company. The person who succeeds in this role will likely have opportunities to expand into leadership and strategy over time. If this role feels like a fit for you, please apply! They are excited to meet the right person! :)

title: Especialista em governança de dados
description:
Empresa está contratando Especialista em governança de dados em rio branco. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Somos o Grupo Casas Bahia, com mais de 70 anos de história, realizando os sonhos de +100 milhões de brasileiros. Aqui, somos protagonistas o tempo todo, sempre com integridade e ética em tudo o que fazemos. A paixão pela nossa gente é o que nos move, e a dedicação total ao cliente é o nosso compromisso diário. Entregamos resultados e buscamos sempre a simplicidade em tudo o que fazemos! Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Governança de Dados para estruturar, evoluir e operacionalizar o framework de governança da nossa Plataforma de Dados. Este papel é fundamental para garantir que os dados da companhia sejam confiáveis, descobríveis, seguros e em conformidade — transformando governança de um requisito de compliance em um habilitador de valor para o negócio. Mais do que definir políticas e padrões, este papel exige profundidade técnica em plataformas modernas de dados, visão sistêmica do ciclo de vida do dado e capacidade de implementar governança de forma prática e escalável, embarcada na esteira de desenvolvimento. O objetivo é elevar a maturidade de governança da companhia, tornando-a um diferencial competitivo sustentado por automação e cultura. Responsabilidades Atuar diretamente na definição, evolução e operacionalização do framework corporativo de Governança de Dados da plataforma. Definir, manter e disseminar políticas, padrões e processos relacionados à governança de dados, incluindo: Catalogação, Classificação, Qualidade de dados, Linhagem, Ciclo de vida do dado; Gestão de acessos. Estruturar e evoluir o catálogo corporativo de dados, garantindo descoberta, documentação, rastreabilidade e contexto de negócio para os ativos de dados. Implementar e governar controles de qualidade de dados, incluindo: Definição de regras; Monitoramento contínuo; Alertas e Processos de remediação. Liderar iniciativas de classificação e proteção de dados sensíveis e pessoais, assegurando conformidade com LGPD e demais regulamentações aplicáveis. Atuar com visão ponta a ponta do ecossistema de dados, compreendendo: Fluxos de dados em arquiteturas modernas (Bronze → Silver → Gold); Linhagem e gestão ativa de metadados; Controles de acesso e segregação de dados; Técnicas de mascaramento, anonimização e proteção de dados. Definir e operacionalizar papéis e responsabilidades de governança: Data Owners; Data Stewards e Custodiantes. Integrar práticas de governança à esteira de desenvolvimento de dados, automatizando controles e reduzindo fricção para os times de engenharia. Atuar em parceria com Segurança da Informação, Privacidade, Jurídico e Compliance em temas relacionados a auditoria, conformidade e resposta a incidentes. Apoiar demandas regulatórias, auditorias e requisições relacionadas a titulares de dados. Definir, acompanhar e comunicar métricas e indicadores de: Maturidade de governança; Qualidade de dados. Promover cultura orientada a dados e disseminar boas práticas de governança na organização, atuando como referência técnica no tema. Requisitos e Qualificações Experiência consolidada em Governança de Dados, preferencialmente em: Ambientes de alta complexidade técnica; Contextos com múltiplos stakeholders; Plataformas analíticas, Data Lake, Data Warehouse ou arquiteturas Lakehouse. Conhecimento sólido e aplicado em: Catalogação, classificação e gestão de metadados; Qualidade, linhagem e ciclo de vida de dados; Gestão de acessos e proteção de dados sensíveis; LGPD e frameworks de governança e privacidade, como DAMA-DMBOK, ISO 27001 e SOC 2. Experiência atuando em conjunto com: Engenharia de Dados; Analytics; Segurança da Informação; Privacidade. Capacidade de implementar governança de forma prática; automatizada; integrada aos processos. Forte habilidade para: traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos aplicáveis; definir métricas e acompanhar evolução de maturidade; navegar com fluidez entre contextos técnicos, jurídicos e de negócio. Excelente comunicação e capacidade de simplificar temas complexos para diferentes públicos (Técnicos; Executivos; Áreas de negócio). Perfil com: Alta autonomia; Visão sistêmica; Capacidade de influência; Forte orientação a impacto e resultados. Capacidade de engajar áreas multifuncionais sem relação hierárquica direta. Perfil colaborativo, pragmático e orientado à construção de soluções escaláveis. Seria muito legal se você tivesse (diferencial): Experiência com: Databricks Unity Catalog, Arquiteturas Lakehouse; Ferramentas de catalogação, qualidade, observabilidade e linhagem de dados. Conhecimento prático em: SQL; Automação de controles; Políticas como código; Data contracts. Experiência com: Integração de logs de auditoria; Soluções de SIEM; Monitoramento de segurança. Certificações em: Governança de Dados; Privacidade; Segurança da Informação. Experiência em: Varejo; E-commerce; Ambientes de alta escala e volumetria de dados. Conhecimento sobre: ANPD; Cenário regulatório brasileiro de proteção de dados. Formação em: Tecnologia; Engenharia; Estatística; Direito Digital; Áreas correlatas. title: Especialista em governança de dados
description:
Empresa está contratando Especialista em governança de dados em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Somos o Grupo Casas Bahia, com mais de 70 anos de história, realizando os sonhos de +100 milhões de brasileiros. Aqui, somos protagonistas o tempo todo, sempre com integridade e ética em tudo o que fazemos. A paixão pela nossa gente é o que nos move, e a dedicação total ao cliente é o nosso compromisso diário. Entregamos resultados e buscamos sempre a simplicidade em tudo o que fazemos! Buscamos um(a) Especialista em Governança de Dados para estruturar, evoluir e operacionalizar o framework de governança da nossa Plataforma de Dados. Este papel é fundamental para garantir que os dados da companhia sejam confiáveis, descobríveis, seguros e em conformidade — transformando governança de um requisito de compliance em um habilitador de valor para o negócio. Mais do que definir políticas e padrões, este papel exige profundidade técnica em plataformas modernas de dados, visão sistêmica do ciclo de vida do dado e capacidade de implementar governança de forma prática e escalável, embarcada na esteira de desenvolvimento. O objetivo é elevar a maturidade de governança da companhia, tornando-a um diferencial competitivo sustentado por automação e cultura. Responsabilidades Atuar diretamente na definição, evolução e operacionalização do framework corporativo de Governança de Dados da plataforma. Definir, manter e disseminar políticas, padrões e processos relacionados à governança de dados, incluindo: Catalogação, Classificação, Qualidade de dados, Linhagem, Ciclo de vida do dado; Gestão de acessos. Estruturar e evoluir o catálogo corporativo de dados, garantindo descoberta, documentação, rastreabilidade e contexto de negócio para os ativos de dados. Implementar e governar controles de qualidade de dados, incluindo: Definição de regras; Monitoramento contínuo; Alertas e Processos de remediação. Liderar iniciativas de classificação e proteção de dados sensíveis e pessoais, assegurando conformidade com LGPD e demais regulamentações aplicáveis. Atuar com visão ponta a ponta do ecossistema de dados, compreendendo: Fluxos de dados em arquiteturas modernas (Bronze → Silver → Gold); Linhagem e gestão ativa de metadados; Controles de acesso e segregação de dados; Técnicas de mascaramento, anonimização e proteção de dados. Definir e operacionalizar papéis e responsabilidades de governança: Data Owners; Data Stewards e Custodiantes. Integrar práticas de governança à esteira de desenvolvimento de dados, automatizando controles e reduzindo fricção para os times de engenharia. Atuar em parceria com Segurança da Informação, Privacidade, Jurídico e Compliance em temas relacionados a auditoria, conformidade e resposta a incidentes. Apoiar demandas regulatórias, auditorias e requisições relacionadas a titulares de dados. Definir, acompanhar e comunicar métricas e indicadores de: Maturidade de governança; Qualidade de dados. Promover cultura orientada a dados e disseminar boas práticas de governança na organização, atuando como referência técnica no tema. Requisitos e Qualificações Experiência consolidada em Governança de Dados, preferencialmente em: Ambientes de alta complexidade técnica; Contextos com múltiplos stakeholders; Plataformas analíticas, Data Lake, Data Warehouse ou arquiteturas Lakehouse. Conhecimento sólido e aplicado em: Catalogação, classificação e gestão de metadados; Qualidade, linhagem e ciclo de vida de dados; Gestão de acessos e proteção de dados sensíveis; LGPD e frameworks de governança e privacidade, como DAMA-DMBOK, ISO 27001 e SOC 2. Experiência atuando em conjunto com: Engenharia de Dados; Analytics; Segurança da Informação; Privacidade. Capacidade de implementar governança de forma prática; automatizada; integrada aos processos. Forte habilidade para: traduzir requisitos regulatórios em controles técnicos aplicáveis; definir métricas e acompanhar evolução de maturidade; navegar com fluidez entre contextos técnicos, jurídicos e de negócio. Excelente comunicação e capacidade de simplificar temas complexos para diferentes públicos (Técnicos; Executivos; Áreas de negócio). Perfil com: Alta autonomia; Visão sistêmica; Capacidade de influência; Forte orientação a impacto e resultados. Capacidade de engajar áreas multifuncionais sem relação hierárquica direta. Perfil colaborativo, pragmático e orientado à construção de soluções escaláveis. Seria muito legal se você tivesse (diferencial): Experiência com: Databricks Unity Catalog, Arquiteturas Lakehouse; Ferramentas de catalogação, qualidade, observabilidade e linhagem de dados. Conhecimento prático em: SQL; Automação de controles; Políticas como código; Data contracts. Experiência com: Integração de logs de auditoria; Soluções de SIEM; Monitoramento de segurança. Certificações em: Governança de Dados; Privacidade; Segurança da Informação. Experiência em: Varejo; E-commerce; Ambientes de alta escala e volumetria de dados. Conhecimento sobre: ANPD; Cenário regulatório brasileiro de proteção de dados. Formação em: Tecnologia; Engenharia; Estatística; Direito Digital; Áreas correlatas. Confira alguns dos benefícios incríveis que preparamos para garantir seu bem-estar e qualidade de vida: PLR/Bônus: Um reconhecimento extra para valorizar o seu esforço e dedicação! Assistência Médica e Odontológica: Para que você tenha toda a segurança e cuidado com a sua saúde e a da sua família. Vale Refeição: Porque sabemos que uma alimentação de qualidade é essencial para o seu dia a dia! Seguro de Vida: Tranquilidade e proteção para você e seus entes queridos. Extensão da Licença Maternidade: 180 dias para nossas mamães aproveitarem o melhor momento com seu bebê! Extensão da Licença Paternidade: 20 dias para que o pais também possa estar presente nos primeiros dias de vida. Incentivo à prática de atividade física: Acesse o Wellhub (Gympass) e o Total Pass para cuidar da saúde e manter o corpo em movimento. Vale Transporte: Para garantir que seu deslocamento até o trabalho seja tranquilo e sem preocupações. Convênio com o SESC: Desfrute de benefícios incríveis em cultura, lazer, saúde e muito mais! Clube de Descontos: Para aproveitarmos de descontos de até 70% em produtos e serviços com mais de 2.000 parceiros no Brasil e América Latina! Day-off no Aniversário: Para celebrar o seu dia com mais tranquilidade e diversão, você tem direito a um descanso no seu aniversário! Desconto em Farmácias: Descontos exclusivos em medicamentos para você economizar no cuidado com a saúde! Nosso compromisso é proporcionar não só um ambiente de trabalho, mas também uma experiência que valorize e cuide de você como pessoa! Estamos aqui para apoiar o seu crescimento pessoal e profissional. #VEMPROGRUPOCASASBAHIA Todas as nossas oportunidades são abertas para candidaturas internas e externas. Pessoas colaboradoras, não deixem de acessar a nossa política de recrutamento interno no Service Now para conferir os requisitos e as premissas do programa.

title: Marketing designer
description:
Nova oportunidade para Marketing designer em rio branco. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

AI Marketing Designer Full-time, Remote | US Central Time Business Hours A letter from our client Our client wanted us to share this role directly in their own words because they're looking for someone exceptional to help them continue growing the right way. Over the past decade, their agency has grown to support 100+ clients across multiple industries, and they are continuing to scale carefully and intentionally. Maintaining a healthy team culture, avoiding burnout, and delivering high-quality work are major priorities for them. Their clients range from mission-driven organizations changing lives, to restaurant and hospitality brands, to innovative tech companies building exciting products. In recent years, the agency has become a trusted partner for businesses that previously had poor experiences with marketing agencies and lost confidence in the process. Their mission is not only to deliver great work, but also to help educate businesses on how modern digital marketing should actually be done. Why this role exists Currently, the owner personally handles much of the AI-assisted production work within the agency. This includes designing social media content, building websites, generating content with AI tools, and migrating websites onto a modern development stack. The systems are working extremely well, allowing the agency to move faster than teams much larger in size. However, he has become the bottleneck. They are now looking for someone who can take ownership of execution so leadership can focus more heavily on strategy, growth, and client relationships. The role This position is equal parts: AI fluency Design and web development Both skill sets must be strong. On the AI side: Their ideal candidate actively uses tools like Claude, Chat GPT, and Gemini as part of a daily workflow. They understand prompting for content, imagery, coding, research, and strategy. They see AI as a multiplier for creativity and execution rather than a replacement for skill. On the design and development side: The candidate should be able to design professionally in Canva and Photoshop while maintaining brand consistency across multiple industries and aesthetics. They should also feel comfortable building and migrating websites using tools such as Next.js, Vercel, Git Hub, and AI-assisted coding workflows. The team values people who understand the balance between beautiful design and conversion-focused performance. Agency experience is strongly preferred, especially for someone familiar with fast turnarounds, proactive communication, and problem-solving before issues escalate. What the role includes Designing social media content for multiple brands and industries Building and migrating websites onto modern frameworks Using AI tools to accelerate production workflows Assisting with content creation, research, image generation, and code scaffolding Creating designs that are both visually strong and performance-driven Staying current on new AI tools, workflows, and technologies Collaborating with leadership to improve internal systems and efficiency What our client is looking for Strong AI workflow experience using tools like Claude, Chat GPT, or Gemini Experience with AI-assisted coding tools Professional Canva and Photoshop skills Comfort using Git Hub, Vercel, and modern web development workflows Basic SEO understanding Strong understanding of social media design across platforms Strong written and spoken English Availability during US Central Time business hours Previous agency experience preferred A highly proactive and self-directed mindset What they DO NOT want Someone who requires constant follow-up Someone who treats AI as a gimmick or shortcut Someone who forces one design style onto every brand Someone who confuses being busy with being effective Someone unwilling to continuously learn and adapt Portfolio required Applicants must submit a live portfolio URL with their application. Their team would like to see: At least 5 projects A mix of social media and website work At least one live website built end-to-end Optional examples showing how AI supported the workflow What it's like working with them They work hard, move quickly, and genuinely enjoy what they do. Their culture values humility, creativity, initiative, and excellence. There is strong room for growth within the company. The person who succeeds in this role will likely have opportunities to expand into leadership and strategy over time. If this role feels like a fit for you, please apply! They are excited to meet the right person! :)

title: Hardware engineer
description:
Empresa está contratando Hardware engineer em manaus. Confira requisitos e envie seu currículo.

Hardware Electronics Engineer Be a founding member of Quectel's new LATAM hub in Manaus Location Manaus, Amazonas, Brazil Role Hardware Electronics Engineer – LATAM Level Mid-Level (1-3 years of experience) Type Full-Time, On-Site Languages Portuguese & English required · Spanish a plus About Quectel Quectel is one of the world's leading suppliers of cellular Io T modules, antennas, and connectivity services, with more than 4,000 professionals across 8 R& D centers and 50+ sales offices worldwide. Our technology powers everything from smart meters and connected cars to industrial robots and point-of-sale terminals — quietly enabling billions of devices to talk to the cloud. A New Chapter: Quectel in Manaus This is something special. Quectel is launching a brand-new operation in Manaus, Brazil — and we're building the founding team right now. Hosted at ICT Manaus (Instituto Centro de Pesquisa e Desenvolvimento em Tecnologia de Software), an accredited Science, Technology and Innovation Institution under SUFRAMA's CAPDA framework, this new setup will become Quectel's regional engine for R& D, customer enablement, and ANATEL certification across Latin America. Joining now means more than taking a job — it means shaping a team, a culture, and a way of working from day one. Your fingerprints will be on everything we build here. Learn more about Quectel: Company website — quectel. Com Our history & global footprint — quectel. Com/company/history LATAM in action — Furukawa Electric Lat Am customer story (Brazil) Follow us on Linked In The Role We're hiring the founding hardware engineer for Quectel's brand-new Manaus operation. You'll be the first technical point of contact — and the technical voice — for customers across Latin America who are building tomorrow's connected products on Quectel modules: automotive telematics, smart energy, industrial Io T, connected payments, and more. Because this is a new setup, you won't be slotting into someone else's playbook. You'll define how we review designs, how we work with ANATEL labs, how we support customers, and how we train the next engineers who join the team. You'll work hands-on with hardware, sit across the table from customer engineering teams, and partner with Quectel's global R& D centers to bring solutions home for the LATAM market. "Joining a brand-new operation means you're not just doing the work — you're deciding how the work gets done. That's rare, and it's the reason engineers stay." What You'll Do Partner with LATAM customers to understand their products, then design hardware architectures and recommend the right Quectel solutions. Review schematics and PCB layouts in Altium, Cadence, or PADS — and turn your feedback into better, more reliable designs. Get hands-on at the bench: power supply analysis, signal integrity, oscilloscope work, debugging interface and certification issues. Be the trusted technical voice for our LATAM customers — answering tough questions and solving complex problems alongside our global engineering teams. Lead technical discussions with customers and certification labs, including ANATEL homologation activities. Write the application notes, design guidelines, and FAQs that help customers ship faster. Train internal FAE and Sales teams across the region — your expertise will scale across LATAM. Support the project team with BOM preparation for fast, accurate customer quotations. What You Bring Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Computer Engineering, or a related field. 3–5 years of hardware design or hardware support experience — bonus if you've worked in customer-facing or FAE roles. Solid grasp of hardware fundamentals: CPU, memory, PMU, system interfaces. Strong skills in power supply design, power sequencing, charging, and power consumption analysis. Comfortable with serial interfaces — I2 C, SPI, UART, USIM — for integration and debug. Confident with bench tools: power supplies, multimeters, oscilloscopes. Hands-on with at least one EDA tool (Altium Designer, Cadence, or PADS). Fluent in English and Portuguese; Spanish is a plus. Bonus Points For Experience designing PCBA end-to-end. Deep knowledge of USB 2.0/3.0, USB hub architecture, USB Type-C. Experience with high-speed interfaces: MIPI DSI/CSI, PCIe, SDIO. RF testing experience across cellular (2 G/3 G/4 G/5 G) and Wi-Fi 802.11. Background in PC, mobile, server, or FWA system integration. Prior ANATEL homologation experience. Team leadership or technical mentoring experience. The Tech You'll Work With Quectel's full product portfolio — cellular (5 G/LTE/LPWA), GNSS, smart modules, and antennas. Quectel services — including device certification work for ANATEL and other regional bodies. See it in action — Quectel customer stories from automotive, smart metering, agribusiness, and more. Why You'll Love Working Here Founding-team energy — you're not joining an established office, you're building one. The processes, the culture, the technical playbook — you'll help write it. Real impact from day one — your decisions and designs ship inside products used by millions across LATAM. Backed by a global leader — startup feel, but with the technology, customers, and resources of a 4,000-person publicly-listed Io T company behind you. Direct line to global R& D — work side-by-side with our R& D centers in China, Europe, and North America while staying rooted in Manaus's growing tech ecosystem. Cutting-edge technology — 5 G, LPWA, AI at the edge, smart camera modules, and the next generation of connected devices. Career growth on a fast curve — early team members typically grow into senior technical or leadership roles as the operation scales. Customer-facing exposure — directly shape how leading LATAM brands build their connected products. Competitive package — attractive compensation, benefits, and the stability of a global market leader. Compensation & Benefits Competitive base salary aligned with LATAM market benchmarks. Performance bonus / sales commission structure (role dependent). Flexible meal and grocery vouchers (meal allowance / food allowance). Health insurance with no co-pay. Life insurance. Paid time off. International travel opportunities — HQ visits and global trade shows. Ready to Apply? If this sounds like your kind of challenge, we'd love to hear from you. Send your CV (in English) along with a short note about what excites you most about the role. We review applications on a rolling basis. Apply via: sasha.saini@ | Browse open roles: quectel. Com/recruitment Quectel is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

title: Full stack engineer (python/react/ai tools)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Full stack engineer (python/react/ai tools) em rio branco. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Us Yipit Data is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475 M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1 B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments. Our engineering team builds agentic solutions that data and research teams utilize to transform petabytes of raw data into strategic intelligence. Our resulting product delivers accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers — ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies — depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. We operate globally with offices in the US (NYC, Austin, Miami, Mountain View), APAC (Hong Kong, Shanghai, Beijing, Guangzhou, Singapore), and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture — recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years — emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.What It’s Like to Work at Yipit Data Yipit Data isn’t a place for coasting — it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals. From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers. Ownership That Matters:You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes Rapid Growth:We compress years of learning into months Merit Over Titles:Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure Velocity with Purpose:We move fast, support each other, and aim high — always with purpose and intentionAbout The Role We’re looking for a seasoned, high-output engineer who can develop our rapidly growing agent platform for our Revenue organization. This individual will sit on our Infrastructure team that builds AI-native solutions used by the entire company to find, convert, and better enable customers with the products we launch. The ideal candidate possesses 3+ years of architecting and developing full-stack applications, proficient data analytics skills, strong interest in agentic workflows, and 5+ years working on applications or codebases built with Python, Databricks, React/Java Script/Type Script, and AWS. The ideal candidate treats AI coding tools as core infrastructure for how they work — not a novelty. You’ve shipped full-stack applications, you’re comfortable navigating ambiguity, and you are customer-obsessed in your approach to improving software.As a Senior Software Engineer, You Will Own features and systems end-to-end across multiple product surfaces — architecture, implementation, deployment, and iteration Architect and deliver solutions for our Revenue, Revenue Operations, and Business Development teams – including data tools, applications, and agentic orchestrators Serve as a subject matter expert across the whole stack, and report directly to the Chief Architect, who will provide hands-on mentorship in cutting‑edge AI-native development, big data analytics, and cloud infrastructure. title: Senior revops analyst - churn
description:
Nova oportunidade para Senior revops analyst - churn em rio branco. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Contract Type:Fixed-Term Contract (Maternity Leave Cover) Duration:6 months initially, with potential extension to 9 months.About the Role We are seekinga Senior Rev Ops Analyst - Churnto join our Customer organisation. Reporting to the Rev Ops Senior Manager - Customer, this role will lead the reporting, analysis, and process evolution of churn performance as the business scales across multiple business units. This is a highly visible analytical role responsible for ensuring customer churn, revenue impact, retention activity, and related operational metrics are reported accurately, consistently, and with clear business insight. You will partner closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Finance, Rev Ops, and senior leadership to turn churn data into actionable commentary and decisions. The role will strengthen Salesforce and related reporting processes as reliable systems of record, while continuously improving the cadence, quality, and efficiency of churn reporting across the organisation.Key Responsibilities Churn Reporting & Revenue Impact Own reporting of customer churn and associated revenue impact across all business units. Ensure accuracy across multiple methodologies, reconcile results where required, and translate the numbers into a clear story that can be understood and acted on by senior leaders. Retention Analysis & Insight Analyse the customer(churn pipeline and build reporting that delivers insight into retention initiatives, discount usage, save rates, customer contact rates, customer health status, and other leading or lagging indicators of churn risk. Process Standardisation & Continuous Improvement Drive standardisation and evolution of churn reporting processes as systems, definitions, and business processes mature. Proactively identify opportunities to improve the reporting cycle, increase efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance the quality of insight month over month. Salesforce Data Quality & Governance Strengthen Salesforce as a system of record by validating data, identifying reporting exceptions, and partnering with Renewals, Rev Ops, Finance, and Revenue Technology stakeholders to ensure dashboards are accurate and items that are not true churn are not reported as churn. Monthly Business Review Preparation & Presentation Prepare materials, briefing documents, and commentary for monthly business reviews. Deep dive into reported numbers, explain key movements and drivers, present insights to senior leaders including the CFO and CCO, respond to queries, track actions, and evolve the reporting process.Required Qualifications & Experience Technical & Operational Expertise Strong experience in an analytical, finance, revenue operations, customer operations, or similar data-driven role. Bachelor's degree minimum, ideally in Economics, Finance, Business, Data Analytics, or a related field. Strong working knowledge of Salesforce, particularly opportunity management, renewal and churn data, reporting structures, and data flows that impact customer and revenue reporting. High proficiency in Excel, with the ability to manage complex calculations, reconcile datasets, investigate variances, and build structured reporting outputs. Experience with BI or reporting tools such as Power BI is advantageous. Revenue & Churn Acumen Experience working with finance and revenue data, including the concepts of annual recurring revenue (ARR) and contracted annual recurring revenue (CARR) in a subscription or Saa S business. Ability to connect churn revenue metrics to retention activity, customer health indicators, and operational performance metrics. Strong analytical judgement, with the ability to double click into results, identify root causes, and explain whether movements are driven by data quality, process, customer behaviour, commercial actions, or broader business trends. Understanding of customer lifecycle, renewals, retention, and churn management processes is highly desirable. Leadership & Stakeholder Management Competent and confident presenting to, influencing, and constructively challenging senior stakeholders. Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, with experience working across multiple stakeholders in a global organisation. Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English, with the ability to turn complex data into clear insight, concise commentary, and practical recommendations. Proactive, curious, and comfortable operating in an evolving environment where processes, systems, and definitions continue to mature.
